profile.ja:
五車学園に所属する学生対魔忍。
影遁の派生忍法、影獣の術を得意とする。
影から動物型の使い魔を生み出して操る忍術であり、実体化した獣で索敵を行ったり、攻撃させることができる。
しかし未熟なヨルヤの力量では小動物しか出すことは出来ず、日陰の少ない平地や体術が必要な近接戦闘は苦手。
忍法使いとして晩熟気味で近年ようやく発現した。
覚醒するまでは、落ちこぼれの欠落感を空想や読書で満たしており、中でも伝奇異能系ライトノベルやマンガを好む。
結果として中二病をこじらせて、現在も引きずっている自称高貴なる永世者。
普段名乗る名前も通称であり、本名は花村良子。
ふうま一族とは関わりが無いため開眼見込みは皆無だが、一応邪眼に憧れている。
カラコンを付けるなど、無駄に演出を頑張っているようだ。
好物（自称）はトマトジュース。
しかし本当は青臭い風味が嫌いなので、いつもぐいっと飲み干している。
profile.en: She is a student Taimanin at Gosha Academy, skilled in the art of shadow beasts, a derivative of the shadow evasion ninja technique. This ninja art allows her to create and control animal-like minions from shadows, using them for reconnaissance and attacks. However, due to her inexperience, she can only summon small animals, and she struggles with battles in open areas with little shade or those that require close combat. As a ninja, she has developed her abilities rather late, and until recently, she had been filling the void of being a low-achiever with daydreams and reading, particularly fond of fantasy light novels and manga. As a result, she has developed a strong case of "chuunibyou" and still clings to it, calling herself a noble eternal being. The name she usually goes by is an alias, and her real name is Hanamura Ryoko. She has no connection to the Fuuma clan, so the prospect of her awakening to the evil eye is nonexistent, but she does admire it and even wears colored contacts in an attempt to create an image. She claims her favorite food is tomato juice, but in reality, she dislikes the bitter taste and always gulps it down quickly.

text.ja: 妾こそは闇より目覚めし者、対魔忍ヨルヤ――あっ、ちょっと待て、まだカラコン装着が……っ！
text.en: I am the one who has awakened from the darkness, Taimanin Yoruya - ah, wait a minute, I still need to put in my colored contacts...

text.ja: ふっ……妾に触れし者よ、影に呑まれる覚悟はあるか？　……ん？ な、なんで笑うのさ、真剣なのにっ！
text.en: You who have touched me, are you prepared to be consumed by the shadows? ...Huh? Why are you laughing? I'm being serious!

text.ja: 我が影獣は既に布陣済み……ふふ、ここは影の領域と化したのじゃ
text.en: My shadow beasts have already been deployed... Hehe, this place has become a realm of shadows.

text.ja: ラノベ、いや書物を読む時が最も影の力が高まる時なのじゃ。妾の世界に不用意に踏み込むでないぞ、くははっ
text.en: When I read light novels or books, my shadow powers grow stronger... Don't carelessly step into my world, or you'll face the consequences, hah!

text.ja: くっ……この日差し……直射は……苦手っ……そ、外での任務は極力避けたいところじゃ……ぬぅ……
text.en: Ugh... this sunlight... Direct sunlight is... my weakness... I'd like to avoid outdoor missions as much as possible... Ugh...

text.ja: 妾を見つめるその眼差し……もしや、惚れたのか？　その愚かしき情念、影に葬ってやらんでもないぞ
text.en: The way you look at me... Could it be that you've fallen for me? I might just bury that foolish sentiment in the shadows.

text.ja: 真紅のトマトジュースに命の気配を感じるのじゃ……。ごくっ、……うぅ、やっぱり青臭い…
text.en: I sense the pulse of life in this red tomato juice... Gulp... Ugh, it's still bitter...

text.ja: また妾に会いに来たのか。よかろう、闇の帳が降りるまで、ともに時を過ごしてやる
text.en: Have you come to see me again? Very well, let's spend some time together until the darkness falls.

text.ja: はぁ……、妾のこの肌に、触れてみるがよい。その瞬間、汝の魂は妾のものとなるっ……ふふ、どうじゃ、妾の鼓動、聞こえるか？
text.en: Come, touch my skin... In that moment, your soul will belong to me... Hehe, can you hear my heartbeat?

text.ja: ふぅ、んっ、身体が火照って仕方ないのじゃ……んんっ、はぁっ、これが地獄の業火に焼かれるということ……！
text.en: Ahh... my body is burning... This must be what it's like to be burned by the fires of hell...

text.ja: くぅ、ふぅ……、妾はもう汝のトリコになってしまったようじゃ……！　はぁ、はぁ……妾をその逸物で躾けてくれんか……？
text.en: Ahh, I've become your plaything, it seems... Will you discipline me with your... treasure?
